summary: Dominion Energy filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a public offering of senior notes due 2036. The filing sets forth the terms of a debt issuance under an existing shelf registration. There is no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction—a senior note offering by the issuer to raise debt capital. No special-situation event is present.
